notes.title: 2 years old and 2 presents for you!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394962/1fe658d2264611553ed203f708d79919f7be125a.png[/img]

Hello, guys.

On January 17th Male Doll will complete 2 years old. After so many years trying to create a studio in which LGBTQ+ people (like me) could create games and live from their dreams, I finally got it. Today, we are a small team from Brazil working on games that we can relate to, especially when we are talking about products not based on visual mechanics and dating simulators.

We believe games are platforms to talk about diversity and differences and we work everyday to make other LGBTQ+ devs have the opportunity that we didn't have when we were kids.

However, this wouldn’t happen without each of you who have been supporting us every day and giving honest feedback about what we create. We really appreciate everyone who helped us directly and indirectly on this journey. Thank you!

To celebrate this moment, we have two presents for you!

First, we’ve started a raffle on [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] in which 2 people will receive a copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game]Boyfriend’s Rescue[/url], our main project from 2020! If you want to give it a shot, we’ll be glad to welcome you. Also, don’t forget to react to Giveaway Bot’s comment. This raffle ends on Monday 18th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game/

Second, our [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/MaleDollStudio/]shop[/url] is now live! Yeaaah! You can check some products that we’ve made for you like bottoms, t-shirts, spiral notebooks and much more! Check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394962/b552e6839024a3988470fa73f245f73f775e2cdc.png[/img]

Thank you all for being with us and wishlist our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming release[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url], [b]we are about to reach 300 followers![/b]

Cheers,

Victoria

notes.title: A hot present for you! Play our free game on Steam.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394962/dab20af6302ef18ca158a7d7e02d81773c2a326e.png[/img]

Hello, guys!

2020 was definitely one of the hardest years we’ve had due to the world pandemic, but with your help, we created a lot of games and learned a lot of things.

As a way to retribute your support, today we’ve launched “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468180/Bring_me_a_man_Santa/]Bring me a man, Santa[/url]”, a short and FREE music game in which you collect candies to remove the clothes of some of our guys. You can plat it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468180/Bring_me_a_man_Santa/

If you feel like supporting us more, we’ve launched a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1495330/Bring_me_a_man_Santa__Adult_Art_Pack/]DLC[/url] too with all sketches and characters naked from the game. It costs only $2 (20% OFF during its launching week) and it can help us a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1495330/Bring_me_a_man_Santa__Adult_Art_Pack/

Last but not least, [b]we really want to say to you all: THANK YOU! [/b]

We hope you enjoy our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming releases[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops/

Don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam[/url] page. We are heading to 300 followers on Steam!

[h1]Stay tuned.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394962/2df6f5365917fee2275e0cf56be76d3a1a8025f2.png[/img]

Cheers,

Male Doll Team

notes.title: We’re working on controller support!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

We’re extremely excited about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game/]Boyfriend’s Rescue[/url] launching day. This is our biggest project for 2020 and [b]we’re still working on a few improvements, especially the controller support.[/b] Thank you all for your patience and feel free to report any bugs in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280640/discussions/]forum[/url] or joining [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url]. 

Have a good game!

Victoria
